lookup_trace_rule: lookup the Dynamo tracing rule for a given torch object to determine how it should be traced
create_torch_obj_rule_map: build the cached map of torch objects to their Dynamo tracing variable rules
load_torch_object: load a torch object from a fully qualified string name including attribute access via hash separator
get_tensor_method_set: get the set of torch.Tensor methods that are allowed as in-graph functions
allow_callable_id: add a callable id to the set of allowed callables that can enter the FX graph
test_is_aten_op: test whether a given object is an ATen operation or a torch.Tensor method
summarize_trace_rules: summarize the trace rules configuration for torch objects in Dynamo tracing
